verdict.rationale: Undermind is an AI research service that handles user queries and uploaded papers, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the pack documents a training opt-out or a no-training commitment. The only related item is enterprise data removal on request, which is an adjacent deletion control, not a guarantee that data is excluded from model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
